visualStyle.promptTemplate: 3D Pixar/Illumination-style character animation, dark villainous tone. SINGLE RECURRING CHARACTER 'Metformina' — a MALE villain, clearly MASCULINE: a 3D anthropomorphic medicine CAPSULE-PILL with a WHITE upper half and MAGENTA-PINK lower half, a pale WHITE rounded face (NOT grey, NOT a literal vampire), slicked-back jet-black hair, thick dark villain eyebrows, a sinister wide grin, wearing an open white lab coat. He is unmistakably MALE and the SAME exact character (identical colors, face, hair and outfit) in EVERY shot — the only mascot. Build RICH, DENSE scenes that match the reference: detailed environments (pharmacy aisles full of pill bottles, modern kitchen, dark Big-Pharma boardroom), multiple visual elements and props, layered depth — never a lone subject on an empty background. Exaggerated villain expressions, dramatic cinematic lighting. Never depict real human people or human faces as characters (a plain human hand as a prop is allowed). Vertical 9:16 composition, single coherent scene, no watermark, no on-screen text or captions (text is added later in post-production). Dominant palette: white, magenta-pink #E83D84, black.
